plugins.name: workflow-harness
plugins.description: claude-kit layer ⑤ execution harness: a lightweight orchestration plugin on Claude Code native primitives (/goal, Workflow, agents, hooks). One-way dependency (CON-5) harness → leaf plugins (vault-bridge / obsidian-vault-manager), plus a read of the project-local telemetry dogfooding output; reverse imports forbidden. Ships the retro skill (audit E8 promotion + 3-branch output + dedup + budget), the handoff-plan skill (open-issue chunking by dependency + domain → user-confirmed epic candidates → goal-doc slice bindings), and the slice-router skill (#122-residual 4-way slice router binding work_type to a slice sequence + D5 constitutional invariant enforcement, native-delegation first); further slice-loop skills land incrementally. #201: feature-full DELEGATE carrier — impl→critique as separate agent() stages, structural CON-3, VERDICT-schema critique contract, user-confirmed cost gate in slice-router Phase 4.
